title: Companion saved review reader
description: Private production Gateway with real Post, Dismiss and auto-finish, historical list trimming and a transparent delayed-read transport. Requires REVIEW_PROOF_CONTEXT=saved, an owned Android emulator and isolated Metro/Gateway ports. No external publication. Teardown stops the owned services.
